newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs seen facing high volatility.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs seen facing high volatility.

text.p: The key December JGB contract faces a day of high volatility on Thursday with traders expecting significant buying and selling interest after a rough Wednesday session.

Many traders are keen to cover short positions built on a news report quoting Bank of Japan deputy governor Toshihiko Fukui as saying that the BOJ is considering the best timing for a credit tightening.
The news was denied by a senior BOJ official after the market closed. The official said the central bank has no plan for a credit tightening now.
